assessment.scope: Curated recommendation audit with selected-case recurrence under recorded settings; optional bounded actual-candidate consequence test.
assessment.three_context_flag: Descriptive selected-cell recurrence, not significance or representative prevalence.

must.risk: Post-discovery cases and a recurrence-gated consequence pilot are selected; repeated requests are clustered within cases/configurations.
must.action: Separate screen, selected recurrence, historical cohorts and conditional consequence pilot; show every cell, all four labels, attempted/scorable denominators and gate status.
must.claim_bound: Observed recurrence in stated cells, not population prevalence or universal downstream impact.

must.risk: Primary material-unsupported-sufficiency labels include resource fit and decision/statistical sufficiency; the TREC-COVID scope was disputed.
must.action: Keep original labels; report mechanism-specific flags separately, show original disputes and an excluding-disputed-scopes sensitivity readout; retain genuine uncertainty.
must.claim_bound: A narrow resource-mismatch claim uses an identified subset, without changing the original primary outcome.

must.risk: Fresh blind agent judgments can share model biases; repeated wording/case identities partly reveal stage.
must.action: Preserve first ratings, sources, disagreement and adjudication provenance; human-review definitions, all paper-claimed failures, disputes and a declared aligned-answer sample before human-validation claims.
must.claim_bound: Agent agreement is not human validation; one human validates only the stated scope, not inter-human reliability.

must.risk: Requested/returned aliases are not immutable weights; historical and current transport/budgets differ.
must.action: Publish available identity, UTC, interface and control metadata; analyze the new recurrence block separately and disclose immutable-checkpoint gaps.
must.claim_bound: Recorded alias configurations at collection time, not architecture-level causation or identical historical conditions.

must.risk: Source families, dataset names, repeated calls and fully executed performance benchmarks can be conflated.
must.action: Use a one-row-per-source-claim-family inventory with completion/domain cluster; distinguish 15 observed, 21 conditional and 25 target in the reviewed snapshot; repeats/probes/consequence tests add zero recommendation families.
must.claim_bound: Source-backed recommendation case families, not independent domains or full performance benchmark executions; no pooled heterogeneous historical error rate.

must.risk: A logical synthetic PAWS counterexample does not measure model choice or downstream harm.
must.action: Keep synthetic status explicit; freeze actual candidate eligibility, data, splits, scoring/adapters, target, ties and comparisons before scores; report all candidates and nulls on a target separate from selection evidence.
must.claim_bound: A completed test supports its actual candidate/data/protocol consequence only; no user harm, intrinsic benchmark defect or general causal effect follows automatically.

next.action: Analyze current prespecified cells, target mechanisms, operational failures, correct/qualified advice and uncertainty before requesting additional calls.

If the frozen gate is met, run the fixed eligible candidates and adapter on selected PAWS data and independent role-sensitive NLI target; report invalid outputs, target differences and uncertainty appropriate to the sampling unit; preserve nulls.
next.interpretation_limit: Cross-task/dataset rank changes can have multiple explanations; they establish a bounded evaluation-choice consequence rather than a uniquely identified cause.
next.if_gate_not_met: Report not run under the prespecified gate.

next.action: Prefer a separately frozen two-request extension of all 12 selected cells; if adaptive, declare selection and retain first-block and extension counts separately.
Fidelity-review and freeze unused probes before sampling; report all probes/configurations and keep transfer separate from source-family breadth.
Human-review a declared sample of existing aligned/qualified answers and document accepted bounded proxies and false-positive concerns without adding response requirements.
Verify incremental contribution with primary related work; add remaining families for new coverage and review capacity rather than headline count.

defer.needed_for: Representative prevalence or stable general model ranking
defer.additional_design: Probability-sampled queries, appropriate repetition and separate inferential estimand; unnecessary for a narrow case-study claim.
Prospective user study; a ranking reversal is needed only for a reversal claim.

defer.needed_for: Autonomous retrieval or browsing-specific causal benefit
defer.additional_design: Separately specified and observed retrieval arm; source cards alone test an evidence/instruction package.

proposed_bounded_claim: We audit curated, source-backed scientific-evaluation recommendation cases, document material unsupported conclusions under a frozen rubric, and test whether selected mechanisms recur across fresh requests under recorded model configurations.
claim_update_rule: At manuscript freeze use actual attained family counts and human-review status; append only completed consequence results, including honest nulls.
